name: Methyl-DMA
summary: Methyl-DMA, also known as 2,5-dimethoxy-N-methylamphetamine or as N-methyl-2,5-DMA, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families. It is the N-methyl derivative of 2,5-dimethoxyamphetamine (2,5-DMA; DOH).

pharmacology.text: Methyl-DMA shows affinity for serotonin receptors in the rat stomach fundus strip (A2 = 316 nM). Its affinity in this assay was about 2-fold lower than that of 2,5-DMA and about 4-fold lower than that of DOM.

uses.text: Methyl-DMA was studied at Edgewood Arsenal under the code name EA‐1322 in the early 1950s. Methyl-DMA has reportedly been encountered as a novel designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelic phenethylamines related to it can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, a faster heart rate and raised blood pressure, and may trigger psychosis in people prone to it.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。相關的迷幻苯乙胺類可能引起噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳加快與血壓上升，也可能誘發易感者的精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。相关的迷幻苯乙胺类可能引起恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳加快与血压上升，也可能诱发易感者的精神病。

fact.en: Methyl-DMA was tested by the US Army at Edgewood Arsenal in the early 1950s under the code name EA-1322.
fact.zh: Methyl-DMA 在1950年代初曾由美國陸軍在艾奇伍德兵工廠以代號 EA-1322 進行試驗。
fact.zhHans: Methyl-DMA 在1950年代初曾由美国陆军在艾奇伍德兵工厂以代号 EA-1322 进行试验。
